field.label: Enabled
field.help: Include this filter in filters.inc. Disabled filters are not loaded by BIRD.

field.label: Name
field.help: BIRD filter name (must be unique). Must match the include file name without .inc, e.g. NAME → /usr/local/etc/bird/NAME.inc. Use this name in a peer Import field.

field.label: Address family
field.help: IPv4 or IPv6. Each community block rejects the default route first (0.0.0.0/0 for IPv4, ::/0 for IPv6) before accepting other prefixes.

field.label: Community
field.help: Match this BGP community define. Together with Interface this is one IF block in the BIRD filter.

field.label: Interface
field.help: Outgoing interface for this community block: ACTIVE_TUN4_IF, ACTIVE_TUN6_IF, WAN4, WAN6 or Null. WAN devices are set on General. Null writes dest = RTD_BLACKHOLE (no ifname). Use + / − to add or remove blocks; they are written before reject.
